name: Revdoku
description: Private cloud storage and managed email inboxes for AI agents and developers. Store files, receive emails and attachments, and collaborate through authorized access.
capabilities: Store documents, data, and source files in private cloud buckets
Receive email and attachments at each bucket's incoming address
Read decoded message bodies, original email, and attachments with file tools
Share bucket files with authorized people and AI connections
Read, write, and append shared files; coordinate edits with locks and revision checks
Inspect versions and change history; restore earlier files
Sign up in the browser, then connect an existing account
